backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor serving as a placeholder backend with no implemented functionality.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented game features (world generation, bird character, movement, collision, HUD) to their source files and test IDs with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON dictionary providing one-sentence descriptions of each frontend source file for build planning reference.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based design tokens for light and dark themes including colors, borders, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for BlueBirdCraft that preloads the Press Start 2P pixel font and mounts the React app at the root div.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component managing game state between title and playing screens, rendering either TitleScreen or the full 3D Canvas with World, Bird, GameCamera, SkyScene, and HUD.
frontend/src/components/Bird.tsx: Playable blue bird avatar built from BoxGeometry primitives with physics (gravity, flapping), WASD movement, block collision detection, wing animation, and facing direction rotation.
frontend/src/components/GameCamera.tsx: Third-person follow camera that smoothly lerps its position and look-at target behind and above the bird each frame.
frontend/src/components/HUD.tsx: Overlay HUD displaying WASD/Space control hints and live XYZ bird coordinates updated via requestAnimationFrame.
frontend/src/components/SkyScene.tsx: Sets up the scene environment with sky-blue background, fog, ambient/directional/hemisphere lighting, and blocky white cloud decorations.
frontend/src/components/TitleScreen.tsx: Minecraft-inspired title screen featuring an animated bird sprite, styled BlueBirdCraft heading, grass block decorations, a Play button, and a footer with attribution link.
frontend/src/components/World.tsx: React Three Fiber component that renders a Minecraft-style voxel world using instanced meshes grouped by block type (grass, dirt, stone, wood, leaves, water) with per-face materials.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, supporting both anonymous and authenticated (Internet Identity) usage, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status to child components.
frontend/src/hooks/usePlayerControls.ts: Hook that tracks WASD/arrow key and spacebar input via keyboard event listeners, returning a ref with boolean flags for forward, backward, left, right, and flap controls.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder module with no backend queries, indicating the app is currently frontend-only.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet defining a Minecraft-inspired dark theme with CSS custom properties, Tailwind imports, and styles for game UI elements like the title screen, play button, and pixel-art block animations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers around the root App component.
frontend/src/utils/collision.ts: Utility functions for voxel collision detection, including checking block overlap, finding ground Y position, and determining if the player is standing on a block.
frontend/src/utils/worldGenerator.ts: Generates deterministic Minecraft-style voxel terrain using sine-wave pseudo-noise for height, placing grass, dirt, stone layers, and procedural trees, plus helpers to build a block lookup set for collision.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for a Minecraft-themed frontend, extending the theme with pixel fonts, oklch-based color tokens, Minecraft-inspired palette (mc.*), pixel box shadows, and custom keyframe animations.
project_state.json: Project state manifest (version 3) describing a Minecraft-style blue-bird game, listing existing features (3D world, bird character, movement, collision, HUD, UI theme), required image assets, and architectural notes.
